column1: # What bus is coming: AT's realtime feed labels every bus with its operator's
# code and fleet number ("TR3884", "NB5014"). This maps fleet number ranges to
# the model. tools/fleet_survey.py (a step in every CI build) lists the ranges
# on the road that aren't covered here yet.
# Tab-separated: prefix, first, last, model, power (electric|diesel), decks (1|2)
# Sources: AT Metro Wiki model pages, operator announcements, and the ranges
# the survey sees running each route.
# Tranzurban: Scania + BCI double-deckers from 2018 (NX2), CRRCs for the
# Northwestern from 2024-25 (eT12 on the 11T/11W, eD12 on the WX1)
# NZ Bus (Kinetic): the Enviro200 fleet, then CRRC electrics from 2022-23
